title: See Financial Data toggle exists in Cross-Cutting Toggles card
expected: Cross-Cutting Toggles card visible; first toggle titled 'See Financial Data'; switch on the right (case's expected subtitle is a documented placeholder-bug)
actual: Card visible; first toggle titled 'See Financial Data'; switch on right (switchX 1447 > labelX 341); subtitle now shows correct descriptive text 'Controls visibility of pricing, cost, and margin data...' (placeholder bug appears fixed)
reason: Toggle exists in the card exactly as the case asserts; subtitle placeholder-bug resolved

title: Enabling Part Sales Create & Edit while See Financial Data OFF prompts to enable it
expected: Checking Part sales View/Create&Edit while SFD OFF fires a modal 'Enable See Financial Data?'
actual: Checking Part sales View fires modal titled 'Enable See Financial Data?', body 'Part Sales requires See Financial Data. Enable it to grant this permission?', Cancel/Enable buttons; same for Create & Edit

title: Confirmation modal Confirm: auto-enables See Financial and applies the checkbox
expected: Modal closes; See Financial Data ON; Part sales View remains checked
actual: After clicking Enable: modal closed, SFD toggle aria-checked=true, Part sales View aria-checked=true

title: Confirmation modal Cancel: reverts the checkbox change
expected: Modal closes; Part sales View unchecked; See Financial Data remains OFF
actual: After clicking Cancel (cancel_financial_data_confirm): modal closed, Part sales View aria-checked=false, SFD aria-checked=false

title: Same confirmation modal fires for Invoicing & Payments while See Financial Data OFF
expected: Modal 'Enable See Financial Data?', body names Invoicing & Payments, Cancel/Enable
actual: Invoicing & payments Create & Edit fires modal 'Enable See Financial Data?' body 'Invoicing & Payments requires See Financial Data. Enable it to grant this permission?' Cancel/Enable; only resource name differs from Part Sales modal

title: Turning See Financial OFF auto-clears Part sales, Invoicing and Payments CRUDs, and the Order Parts sub-toggle
expected: Turning SFD OFF auto-unchecks all 6 Part sales + Invoicing CRUD checkboxes AND auto-clears the Order Parts sub-toggle (Order Parts requires SFD)
actual: Set SFD ON + Part sales V/E/D + Invoicing V/E/D + WO View + Order Parts ON. Turning SFD OFF shows confirm 'Disabling See Financial Data will also disable Part Sales and Invoicing & Payments. Continue?'; after Disable the 6 Part sales/Invoicing CRUD checkboxes are cleared/removed, BUT the Order Parts sub-toggle remained ON (aria-checked=true) and is not mentioned in the dialog
reason: Order Parts sub-toggle is NOT auto-cleared when SFD is turned off, contradicting expected point 2/3

title: Enabling Order Parts while See Financial Data is OFF prompts to also enable See Financial Data
expected: Turning ON Order Parts while SFD OFF triggers a prompt to enable SFD; accepting turns SFD ON; cannot end with Order Parts ON while SFD OFF
actual: With SFD OFF and Work Orders View ON (required to enable Order Parts), toggling Order Parts ON produced NO prompt/modal; Order Parts ended ON (aria-checked=true) while SFD remained OFF (aria-checked=false)
reason: No prompt appears and Order Parts can be enabled while SFD is OFF, directly contradicting expected
